headline: Pre-heat gate failed — restart from prep_ladder, re-run mini
notes: Selected checkpoint is .crd; prefer a .res restart when available (e.g. baseline.res).
Pre-heat gate failed (intra-monomer overlap after MLpot mini). Re-run from prep_ladder with md_stages mini,heat,equi.
config_yaml:
# Suggested resume config (generated by mmml md-system)
# prior job: r1_test exit=2
include:
  - presets/heat-dt0.25-scale.yaml
  - presets/dynamics-flyoff-strict.yaml

defaults:
  backend: 'pycharmm'
  dynamics_intra_rescue_sd_steps: 400
  md_stages: 'mini,heat,equi'
  output_dir: 'dichloromethane/n50/t260/r1_test'
  restart_from: '/cluster/home/boittier/mmml_tutorial/acodcm/dichloromethane/n50/t260/r1_test/prep_ladder/002_pre_mlpot_monomer_repack.crd'
shell_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Suggested resume (wrap with ./scripts/mmml-charmm-mpirun.sh on GPU nodes).
# prior job: r1_test exit=2
CMD=(
  mmml
  md-system
  --output-dir
  dichloromethane/n50/t260/r1_test
  --backend
  pycharmm
  --restart-from
  /cluster/home/boittier/mmml_tutorial/acodcm/dichloromethane/n50/t260/r1_test/prep_ladder/002_pre_mlpot_monomer_repack.crd
  --md-stages
  mini,heat,equi
  --dynamics-intra-rescue-sd-steps
  400
)
exec "${CMD[@]}"
